observations.reduction_scope: Named public/work counters sum; maxima never sum; CPU/I/O are before-to-after-product differences (failure falls back to final); Store changes are signed product-boundary differences. Spool boundary maxima are distinct from mutation-event high-water.

spool.scope: owned process Workspace spool/capture/rebase regular files; excludes output logs and directory allocation
owned process Workspace spool/capture/rebase regular files; excludes output logs and directory allocation

receipt.scope: full current namespace/global inode/metadata/aliases; selected changed+witness bytes; unchanged file-state/extent/payload subgraph references certified, those current subgraph bytes not read

verification.assurance: current selected extents and qualified unchanged content-root references; exhaustive object/storage census deferred

resource_observations.coverage_scope: selected-run dispatch through all reached product, verification and recovery work and local Client/Store drops; excludes process-wide daemon-owner teardown and supervisor cleanup
resource_observations.precision: causally-bracketed samples; not exact continuous phase/category maxima

regular_payload_sharing.scope: logical regular-file payload sharing; excludes canonical wrappers, metadata and physical Store slack; not an emitted-CAS-hit fraction

verification_summary.scope: Independent matching verification execution; per-step state and retained-union gauges are endpoints, never summed across snapshots. Step-new canonical counts mean first reachable in the union, not emitted CAS insertions.
